text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That Nishino Flower is quick!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I was watching with bated breath, worried that she'd be crushed by the elite competition…

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: But I get why she was fast-tracked now. She seems to have an abundance of natural talent!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Hm? Hold on a sec…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: …Is it just me, or is she really struggling?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text: Flower?! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? …Mom and Dad?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You really came… all the way to Sapporo… to watch me… Huff!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh, Flower! Take some deep breaths, dear. That'll help you! Right, honey?!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text: U-um, I, uh… T-Trainer, some assistance, please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Nishino Flower in a state of total exhaustion and her parents sick with worry, it takes me a few minutes to calm the situation.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sorry for making you worry… I'm fine now.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? No pain in your chest or anywhere else? You're not injured, are you?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mom, please calm down! I'm not hurt.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I was just a little tired is all.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text: Well, it sure didn't look like you were just "a little" tired to us. Competing in races might be too hard on you after all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All the other Umamusume are exhausted after racing too! Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Honestly, her fatigue is far worse than that of the other racers. Her still-growing body puts her at a disadvantage, and that won't change anytime soon…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, I don't want to worry her parents even more. As long as I provide the right care, this shouldn't be a major issue.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: See? It's normal. But everyone goes out there and runs with all they have.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So please don't worry so much. I promise I'll get plenty of rest!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But more importantly, it's official now! I made my race debut! I want to see smiles on your faces.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm sorry. You're right… Congratulations, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm going to go get changed… Just wait here until I'm done.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I sure made everyone worry…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Maybe I'm still not cut out for this yet. I'll train hard and build up more physical endurance.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (But I wonder if that will be enough. If I'm going to get people to acknowledge Trainer…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I'll have to do something major—like win a big race… I bet that'll drive away all those worries!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um… So what was it that we needed to decide on?
choice_data_list: Let's think about your next race goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Based on what I saw of her running today, I think she'd perform very well in the junior-year G1 races. The thing is…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Considering how exhausted she was after today's race, steady physical conditioning might be the way to go. With that in mind…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'd like to compete in a G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I understand what it means to run in a G1 race. Even the most talented of the older students only have a slim chance of victory…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Even so… I want to give it a try. You might think it's too soon, but I—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower searches for the right words. However, her determination comes through loud and clear. In that case, I need to support her!
choice_data_list: All right! A G1 race it is!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'll do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Considering the length of the junior G1 races, perhaps a mile race like the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies would be the best place for Nishino Flower to start.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let me see… I'd like to enter the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's a race that many of the wonderful, older Umamusume like Gold City have competed in.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I've always dreamed about running in it, just like they did!
choice_data_list: Then we'll prepare for the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll put my all into this!
choice_data_list: (I've got to work even harder too.)
(I've got to work even harder too.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her so worn out after the race really caught me off guard. I can't let her see me like that ever again, so I need to be better prepared.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All right. Time to plant lots of flowers!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oho? Someone's a real go-getter.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hello, Sky! Just woke up from a nap?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm, yeah. More importantly…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Congrats on your debut. Let me reward that great effort in an exclusively Sei way: a round of applause.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Seiun Sky's a bit mysterious, but she's also very kind and always looks out for me.)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now, a question for the Umamusume of the hour!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What are you doing, exactly? You've been digging in the dirt like there's no tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I sure am. This is all to make a new flower bed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …But, um, the reason I'm making it is a secret! So… ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Gotcha—my lips are sealed. But will you let me in on it at least?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Well, I want to craft this flower bed into a message for my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Every time I run in a race, I'll add more flowers. And once it's full of beautiful blossoms, it'll be time to show it off.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I hope it'll make Trainer happy… I just really want to give them more confidence!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And when that day comes…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I want to tell Trainer it's thanks to the effort we put in together that there are so many flowers blossoming here.)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ohh, now you got me feeling jelly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nothin' at all. Anyhoo, you'd better enter plenty of races, then.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Good answer. Now, I think I'll play in the dirt for a bit too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A-are you sure? Your uniform will get dirty!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm always covered in grass anyway… Plus, I can always use one of my exclusive life hacks.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If I show up in front of King all dirty, she'll clean me up right away. She gives me a good scolding, too, but no biggie!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-you don't have to go that far! I'll wash your uniform for you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, maybe I'll tidy up this spot.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …That'd be a great help, Sky! ♪
